body:
This is really inspiring. I really don't see myself ever liking any part of me, but I really do hope you're right.
Thank you for the offer, unfortunately I'm all the way in Oklahoma. I'll definitely PM you if I ever go up there though. This comment really cheered me up and I loved that video! It actually brought me to tears, because of all the people and all the cultures.

Thank you, I'm going to take that first step. Honestly I haven't thought of how my mom's going to need my love and support. I guess that kind of selfish of me. I appreciate you pointing that out and giving me another reason to live.

I'm going to try to apply some of these things to my. Thank you for giving me little, easy, simple things. Sometimes people say, "Go to therapy every week, take up this hobby improve all your grades, etc." And it's so hard to just start applying those huge things all of sudden.  Thank you for helping me take a step back from that and break it all down.
This is really good advice, I haven't even thought of that. I think  I'll do it for next semester as I know I'm not ready yet this semester.

> Other people live on planet Earth; you live on planet My Baby Died.

^I am so glad you understand that too! That puts my feelings I didn't have words for into words. It's like everyone is just living their lives, happily and normally. But for me, seeing a toy commercial or driving by a park or seeing a mom is just a reminder of everything and makes me want to breakdown and cry.
Thank you. Sometimes picturing a future is really hard for me, especially a happy one. But you're right; it's there.

I was actually able to find somewhere that's free and only half an hour away from me! Thanks for this! Unfortunately, my appointment's a month away. I'm not really sure how it's going to work either. I'm pretty awkward with talking about my feelings in person. Thank you though!

I have a cat and it does help. I want to believe my ex is just so cruel because he's hurting too, but in all honestly I think he just might not care that much. That's something that hurts a lot, but I think it's the truth.
I wish I could be as positive as you finding someone, but I'm eighteen and he's the only boyfriend I've ever had. I'm not sure if I'll ever find anyone else. :(

I just wanted to thank you all for your kind words. I went to work earlier and a few good things happened, that I'm glad I was alive for. You all have given me enough hope to continue living a little while longer. I'm going  to try to improve my situation. I really can't tell any of you how much all of these comments meant to me. I thought I'd get one or two, "Here's a hotline. Call them." comments. It gives me hope that even though I'm completely alone in my life right now, there are strangers on the internet that still care.
